name: datafiniti_property_search
description: Search Datafiniti's US property database (100M+ records) — returns address, square footage, bed/bath counts, property type, ownership (people), and tax/assessment data. Uses the Datafiniti field:value query language. Example: datafiniti_property_search({ query: "country:US AND city:\"Austin\" AND numBedroom:3", num_records: 5, _apiKey: "your-token" })

query.description: Datafiniti query, e.g. `country:US AND province:TX AND city:"Austin"`. Fields: country, province, city, postalCode, propertyType, numBedroom, numBathroom, address.

num_records.description: Max records to return (default 10, set 0 to get only num_found at no credit cost).

_apiKey.description: Datafiniti API token (from https://portal.datafiniti.co/). Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

name: datafiniti_business_search
description: Search Datafiniti's business/location database — returns name, address, category, phone, website, lat/lon, and reviews. Uses the Datafiniti field:value query language. Example: datafiniti_business_search({ query: "country:US AND categories:Restaurant AND city:\"Seattle\"", num_records: 5, _apiKey: "your-token" })

query.description: Datafiniti query, e.g. `country:US AND city:"Seattle" AND categories:Restaurant`. Fields: name, categories, city, province, postalCode, country, phones, websites.

num_records.description: Max records to return (default 10, set 0 to get only num_found at no credit cost).

_apiKey.description: Datafiniti API token (from https://portal.datafiniti.co/). Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

name: datafiniti_product_search
description: Search Datafiniti's product database (250M+ records) — returns name, brand, categories, prices (amount/currency/merchant), and identifiers (UPC/ASIN/SKU). Uses the Datafiniti field:value query language. Example: datafiniti_product_search({ query: "brand:Nike AND categories:Shoes", num_records: 5, _apiKey: "your-token" })

query.description: Datafiniti query, e.g. `brand:Nike AND categories:Shoes`. Fields: name, brand, manufacturer, categories, primaryCategories, prices, upc, asins, sku.

num_records.description: Max records to return (default 10, set 0 to get only num_found at no credit cost).

_apiKey.description: Datafiniti API token (from https://portal.datafiniti.co/). Sent as Authorization: Bearer.
